title: Step 3: A Real Shortener
story: Now remember which link belongs to which code.
goal: Add class Shortener with shorten(url) and expand(code). The same link must always get the same code.
hints: Keep a list of urls and a dict from url to its number.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
